banking_and_vectors.mapper_note: Mapper 69/Sunsoft FME-7 uses bank switching, so a CPU address cannot be converted to a unique file offset without the active PRG bank register state.

reset_stub_at_prg_end.note: The fixed-bank reset area contains mapper-register writes and a jump into a banked CPU window; runtime bank tracing is needed to follow text routines confidently.

fixed_width_text_structure.trailer_note: Trailer values vary but are not safely interpretable as ROM pointers from static inspection alone.
